# Quid Pro Quo - core pact engine
#
# Saved scope conventions used by every effect in this file:
#   scope:qpq_payer          the party who proposed and pays
#   scope:qpq_agent          the party who acts
#   scope:qpq_target         the character the Ask aims at (optional)
#   scope:qpq_target_title   the title the Ask aims at (optional)
#   scope:qpq_target_artifact the artifact the Ask aims at (optional)
#   scope:qpq_story          the pact's story cycle
#
# Per-kind logic lives in qpq_kind_effects.txt / qpq_kind_triggers.txt (generated by tools/qpq_gen.py).

############################################################
# SEALING
############################################################

# Called with the scopes above saved, plus scope values
#   qpq_payer_tier / qpq_agent_tier (0-5) and qpq_o_* offer flags (yes/no).
qpq_seal_pact_effect = {
	# The term as a scope value, so durations show correctly in tooltips before the story exists: the one the
	# two sides settled on (the deal panel saves it, 1 to 20 years), else the deed's usual one
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_term_months } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_term_months value = $TERM$ }
	}
	# Discretion: a pact with floor 0 may be published as a Charter; anything private is at least Tier I
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_charter ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_is_charter value = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_payer_tier < 1 }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_agent_tier < 1 }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = 1 }
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_payer = {
		create_story = {
			type = qpq_pact_story
			save_scope_as = qpq_story
		}
	}
	# The story, its mirror and the secrets do not exist while the game builds a tooltip:
	# everything that touches them is guarded with ?= / exists and kept out of the tooltip.
	scope:qpq_story ?= {
		set_variable = { name = qpq_kind value = flag:$KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_payer value = scope:qpq_payer }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_agent value = scope:qpq_agent }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target value = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target_title value = scope:qpq_target_title }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_artifact }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target_artifact value = scope:qpq_target_artifact }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_term value = scope:qpq_term_months }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = scope:qpq_payer_tier }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = scope:qpq_agent_tier }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_months_left value = scope:qpq_term_months }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_is_charter }
			set_variable = qpq_charter
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_story }
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:qpq_payer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story }
			}
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story }
				# Display-only mirror so the agent sees the pact in their Situations window too
				create_story = {
					type = qpq_pact_mirror_story
					save_scope_as = qpq_mirror
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_mirror ?= {
		set_variable = { name = qpq_main value = scope:qpq_story }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_kind value = flag:$KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_payer value = scope:qpq_payer }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_agent value = scope:qpq_agent }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target value = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target_title value = scope:qpq_target_title }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_months_left value = scope:qpq_term_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_story
			exists = scope:qpq_mirror
		}
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = { name = qpq_mirror value = scope:qpq_mirror } }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_is_charter }
		qpq_publish_charter_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		qpq_create_pact_secrets_effect = { KIND = $KIND$ SECRET = $SECRET$ }
	}

	qpq_store_and_pay_offers_effect = yes
	qpq_k_$KIND$_on_seal_effect = yes
	scope:qpq_story ?= { qpq_sync_mirror_effect = yes }

	scope:qpq_payer = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_good_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_sealed_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_sealed_payer_desc
			left_icon = scope:qpq_agent
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_good_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_sealed_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_sealed_agent_desc
			left_icon = scope:qpq_payer
		}
	}
	# the next pact sealed in this effect (the other leg of a deal) brings its own term
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_term_months
}

# Adds a pact secret of the right tier to OWNER, aimed at the other party (TARGET)
qpq_add_tiered_secret_effect = {
	$OWNER$ = {
		if = {
			limit = { $TIER$ <= 1 }
			add_secret = { type = qpq_secret_$SECRET$_1 target = $TARGET$ save_scope_as = $SAVE$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $TIER$ = 2 }
			add_secret = { type = qpq_secret_$SECRET$_2 target = $TARGET$ save_scope_as = $SAVE$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $TIER$ = 3 }
			add_secret = { type = qpq_secret_$SECRET$_3 target = $TARGET$ save_scope_as = $SAVE$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $TIER$ = 4 }
			add_secret = { type = qpq_secret_$SECRET$_4 target = $TARGET$ save_scope_as = $SAVE$ }
		}
		else = {
			add_secret = { type = qpq_secret_$SECRET$_5 target = $TARGET$ save_scope_as = $SAVE$ }
		}
	}
}

# Writes the shared pact record onto one half
qpq_write_secret_record_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = qpq_kind value = flag:$KIND$ }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_story }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_story value = scope:qpq_story }
	}
	set_variable = { name = qpq_payer value = scope:qpq_payer }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_agent value = scope:qpq_agent }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_target value = scope:qpq_target }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_target_title value = scope:qpq_target_title }
	}
	set_variable = { name = qpq_fresh value = yes years = 20 }
}

qpq_create_pact_secrets_effect = {
	qpq_add_tiered_secret_effect = {
		OWNER = scope:qpq_payer
		TARGET = scope:qpq_agent
		TIER = scope:qpq_payer_tier
		SECRET = $SECRET$
		SAVE = qpq_payer_secret
	}
	qpq_add_tiered_secret_effect = {
		OWNER = scope:qpq_agent
		TARGET = scope:qpq_payer
		TIER = scope:qpq_agent_tier
		SECRET = $SECRET$
		SAVE = qpq_agent_secret
	}
	scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= {
		qpq_write_secret_record_effect = { KIND = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_role value = flag:payer }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_owner value = scope:qpq_payer }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_tier value = scope:qpq_payer_tier }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_twin value = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer.primary_heir }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_heir value = scope:qpq_payer.primary_heir }
		}
		reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
	}
	scope:qpq_agent_secret ?= {
		qpq_write_secret_record_effect = { KIND = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_role value = flag:agent }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_owner value = scope:qpq_agent }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_tier value = scope:qpq_agent_tier }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_twin value = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent.primary_heir }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_heir value = scope:qpq_agent.primary_heir }
		}
		reveal_to = scope:qpq_payer
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_story
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret
			exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret
		}
		scope:qpq_story = {
			set_variable = { name = qpq_payer_secret value = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_agent_secret value = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
		}
	}
}

# Tier 0: the pact is published as a Charter instead of a secret
qpq_publish_charter_effect = {
	# Honourable deals made in the open earn prestige; a scandalous one only pays for it
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_payer_tier <= 0
			scope:qpq_agent_tier <= 0
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain }
		scope:qpq_agent = { add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain }
	}
	# Charter alerts: the target's liege and allies hear of it
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title.holder }
		scope:qpq_target_title.holder = { save_scope_as = qpq_charter_victim }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		scope:qpq_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_charter_victim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_charter_victim }
		scope:qpq_charter_victim = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = liege }
				liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_charter_victim_liege }
			}
		}
		scope:qpq_charter_victim = {
			trigger_event = qpq_pact.80
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_charter_victim_liege }
			scope:qpq_charter_victim_liege = {
				trigger_event = qpq_pact.80
			}
		}
	}
	# Made public at a price: the fallout of a scandalous deal lands now, at half weight, instead of waiting
	# to be exposed. Nothing is left to expose, blackmail or inherit.
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_charter_victim }
		scope:qpq_charter_victim = { save_scope_as = qpq_victim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_payer_tier >= 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = scope:qpq_payer_tier }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_mult value = 50 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_payer_tier >= 4 }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = yes }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = no }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { qpq_apply_half_fallout_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent_tier >= 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = scope:qpq_agent_tier }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_mult value = 50 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_agent_tier >= 4 }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = yes }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = no }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent = { qpq_apply_half_fallout_effect = yes }
	}
}

############################################################
# OFFERS
############################################################

# The fair price in gold, saved by the interaction as scope value qpq_price
qpq_store_and_pay_offers_effect = {
	# Visible effects come first and never go through the new story: while the game builds the
	# tooltip the story, secrets and mirror do not exist yet. Bookkeeping uses "?=" so it is
	# simply skipped then.
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold_lavish ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_gold_total value = { value = scope:qpq_price multiply = 2 } }
	}
	else = {
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_gold_total value = scope:qpq_price }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes
				scope:qpq_o_gold_lavish ?= yes
			}
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_has_gold value = yes }
	}

	# --- Gold paid now (up front, or the first half) ---
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_has_gold
			NOT = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_paid_now value = { value = scope:qpq_gold_total divide = 2 round = yes } }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_paid_now value = scope:qpq_gold_total }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			pay_short_term_gold = {
				target = scope:qpq_agent
				gold = scope:qpq_paid_now
			}
		}
	}

	# --- Claim: fabricated now, so they can pay themselves with a war ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_claim ?= yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title }
			scope:qpq_target_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_claim_title }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.capital_county }
			scope:qpq_target.capital_county = { save_scope_as = qpq_claim_title }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_claim_title }
			scope:qpq_agent = { add_unpressed_claim = scope:qpq_claim_title }
		}
	}

	# --- Office: a council seat now; dismissing them early is a breach ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			qpq_appoint_best_council_seat_effect = { WHO = scope:qpq_agent }
		}
	}

	# --- Hooks ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_payer = { remove_hook = { target = scope:qpq_agent } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_agent = {
			add_hook = {
				type = qpq_my_word_hook
				target = scope:qpq_payer
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_payer = { use_hook = scope:qpq_agent }
	}

	# --- Secrets: the dirt you hold on the people named, the worst of it on each ---
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src
		}
		scope:qpq_deal_land_src = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_land_leg ?= flag:t
					has_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_secret_t
				}
				every_in_list = {
					variable = qpq_deal_gift_secret_t
					qpq_hand_over_secret_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_land_leg ?= flag:i
					has_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_secret_i
				}
				every_in_list = {
					variable = qpq_deal_gift_secret_i
					qpq_hand_over_secret_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Proposals that name no one (the old hub): any secret you hold that they do not know
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes
			NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			random_known_secret = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_agent }
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
				}
				reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}

	# --- Clemency: release them or their kin, drop the charge ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		qpq_offer_clemency_effect = yes
	}

	# --- Arms: men lent until the deadline ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_agent = {
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = qpq_lent_arms_modifier
				months = qpq_term_months_value
			}
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = qpq_lending_arms_modifier
				months = qpq_term_months_value
			}
		}
	}

	# --- Church favour: indulgence and absolution (Christian heads of faith only) ---
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_agent = {
			add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = excommunicated }
				remove_trait = excommunicated
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = qpq_indulgence_modifier
				years = 10
			}
		}
	}

	# --- Things handed over on delivery are chosen now ---
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes
			NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			ordered_held_title = {
				limit = {
					tier = tier_county
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer.capital_county }
				}
				order_by = { value = 0 subtract = development_level }
				save_scope_as = qpq_offer_title
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes
			NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			ordered_character_artifact = {
				order_by = artifact_rarity
				save_scope_as = qpq_offer_artifact
			}
		}
	}

	# --- Bookkeeping on the pact ---
	scope:qpq_story ?= {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_has_gold }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_gold_total value = scope:qpq_gold_total }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
					set_variable = {
						name = qpq_stipend
						value = {
							value = scope:qpq_gold_total
							divide = { value = scope:qpq_term_months divide = 12 min = 1 }
							round = yes
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
					set_variable = { name = qpq_gold_due value = scope:qpq_gold_total }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
					set_variable = {
						name = qpq_gold_due
						value = { value = scope:qpq_gold_total divide = 2 round = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_paid_now }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_paid_now value = scope:qpq_paid_now }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_offer_title }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_offer_title value = scope:qpq_offer_title }
			}
			# Titles chosen in the deal panel: the payer's own, handed over on delivery
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes
					exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src
				}
				scope:qpq_deal_land_src = {
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_land_leg ?= flag:t }
						every_in_list = {
							variable = qpq_deal_land_t
							limit = { holder ?= scope:qpq_payer }
							scope:qpq_story = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_offer_titles target = prev } }
						}
					}
					else = {
						every_in_list = {
							variable = qpq_deal_land_i
							limit = { holder ?= scope:qpq_payer }
							scope:qpq_story = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_offer_titles target = prev } }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_offer_titles }
					random_in_list = {
						variable = qpq_offer_titles
						save_scope_as = qpq_first_title
					}
					set_variable = { name = qpq_offer_title value = scope:qpq_first_title }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_offer_artifact }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_offer_artifact value = scope:qpq_offer_artifact }
			}
			# Artifacts named in the deal panel: the payer's own, handed over on delivery
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes
					exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src
				}
				scope:qpq_deal_land_src = {
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_land_leg ?= flag:t }
						every_in_list = {
							variable = qpq_deal_gift_artifact_t
							limit = { artifact_owner ?= scope:qpq_payer }
							scope:qpq_story = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_offer_artifacts target = prev } }
						}
					}
					else = {
						every_in_list = {
							variable = qpq_deal_gift_artifact_i
							limit = { artifact_owner ?= scope:qpq_payer }
							scope:qpq_story = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_offer_artifacts target = prev } }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_offer_artifacts }
					random_in_list = {
						variable = qpq_offer_artifacts
						save_scope_as = qpq_first_artifact
					}
					set_variable = { name = qpq_offer_artifact value = scope:qpq_first_artifact }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_offer_office
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_offer_contract
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_offer_succession
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_offer_restraint
				scope:qpq_agent = {
					add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_protected_by_restraint target = scope:qpq_story }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_claim ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_claim
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_hook_release
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_my_word
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_secret
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_clemency
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_arms
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_gave_church
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
				set_variable = qpq_used_hook
			}
		}
	}
}

# Root: the person the secrets are on. Hands scope:qpq_agent the worst secret scope:qpq_payer holds on them that
# the agent does not know: a crime first, then what shames, then anything.
qpq_hand_over_secret_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = qpq_gift_subject
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_known_secret = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
					is_criminal_for = secret_owner
				}
			}
			random_known_secret = {
				limit = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
					is_criminal_for = secret_owner
				}
				reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_known_secret = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
					is_shunned_for = secret_owner
				}
			}
			random_known_secret = {
				limit = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
					is_shunned_for = secret_owner
				}
				reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_known_secret = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
				}
			}
			random_known_secret = {
				limit = {
					secret_owner = scope:qpq_gift_subject
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
				}
				reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_appoint_best_council_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { $WHO$ = { is_councillor_of = prev } }
		# Already sits on the council: nothing more to give
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $WHO$.martial >= $WHO$.stewardship $WHO$.martial >= $WHO$.intrigue $WHO$.martial >= $WHO$.diplomacy }
		assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_marshal remove_existing_councillor = yes target = $WHO$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $WHO$.stewardship >= $WHO$.intrigue $WHO$.stewardship >= $WHO$.diplomacy }
		assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_steward remove_existing_councillor = yes target = $WHO$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $WHO$.intrigue >= $WHO$.diplomacy }
		assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_spymaster remove_existing_councillor = yes target = $WHO$ }
	}
	else = {
		assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_chancellor remove_existing_councillor = yes target = $WHO$ }
	}
}

qpq_offer_clemency_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:qpq_payer } }
		scope:qpq_agent = { release_from_prison = yes }
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_prisoner = {
			limit = { is_close_family_of = scope:qpq_agent }
			release_from_prison = yes
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion }
		}
		add_opinion = {
			target = scope:qpq_agent
			modifier = qpq_pardoned_opinion
		}
	}
}

############################################################
# STORY HELPERS
############################################################

# Root: the pact story. Saves the standard scopes.
qpq_load_story_scopes_effect = {
	save_scope_as = qpq_story
	var:qpq_payer = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	var:qpq_agent = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_target }
		var:qpq_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_target_title }
		var:qpq_target_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_target_title }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_target_artifact }
		var:qpq_target_artifact = { save_scope_as = qpq_target_artifact }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_payer_secret }
		var:qpq_payer_secret = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer_secret }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_agent_secret }
		var:qpq_agent_secret = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent_secret }
	}
}

# Monthly heartbeat of every active pact
qpq_story_tick_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes }
		qpq_load_story_scopes_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_payer = { is_alive = yes }
				scope:qpq_agent = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			qpq_kind_tick_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:qpq_payer = { is_alive = no }
					scope:qpq_agent = { is_alive = no }
				}
			}
			qpq_void_pact_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			# The other half of the deal was broken: this one is off
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_released }
			qpq_void_pact_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_kind_invalid_trigger = yes }
			qpq_void_pact_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_kind_delivered_trigger = yes }
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_kind_breached_trigger = yes }
			qpq_breach_pact_effect = { BREACHER = scope:qpq_agent WRONGED = scope:qpq_payer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_payer_broke_terms_trigger = yes }
			qpq_breach_pact_effect = { BREACHER = scope:qpq_payer WRONGED = scope:qpq_agent }
		}
		else = {
			qpq_story_stipend_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_agent = { is_ai = yes }
					qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes
				}
				qpq_kind_ai_attempt_effect = yes
				qpq_ai_consider_breach_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes }
				change_variable = { name = qpq_months_left add = -1 }
				qpq_sync_mirror_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_months_left <= 0 }
					if = {
						limit = { qpq_kind_is_restraint_trigger = yes }
						qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
					}
					else = {
						qpq_breach_pact_effect = { BREACHER = scope:qpq_agent WRONGED = scope:qpq_payer }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


qpq_story_stipend_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_offer_office }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_councillor_of = scope:qpq_payer } }
			set_variable = qpq_office_given
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = var:qpq_stipend
			var:qpq_months_left > 0
		}
		# Every 12 months a yearly installment falls due
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_stipend_counter
			value = {
				value = var:qpq_term
				subtract = var:qpq_months_left
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:qpq_stipend_counter > 0
				qpq_stipend_due_trigger = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { gold >= scope:qpq_story.var:qpq_stipend } }
				scope:qpq_payer = {
					pay_short_term_gold = {
						target = scope:qpq_agent
						gold = scope:qpq_story.var:qpq_stipend
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = qpq_payer_violated
			}
		}
	}
}


# AI agents sometimes renege when the deal has soured
qpq_ai_consider_breach_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = deceitful
					has_trait = arbitrary
					has_trait = fickle
				}
				opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer value <= -40 }
			}
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ai_breach_checked }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ai_breach_checked value = yes months = 12 }
		random = {
			chance = 10
			qpq_breach_pact_effect = { BREACHER = scope:qpq_agent WRONGED = scope:qpq_payer }
		}
	}
}

############################################################
# DELIVERY, BREACH, VOID
############################################################

qpq_deliver_pact_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = qpq_closed value = flag:delivered }
	qpq_kind_on_deliver_effect = yes
	# Releasing payment
	qpq_pay_on_delivery_effect = yes
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_good_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_delivered_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_delivered_payer_desc
			left_icon = scope:qpq_agent
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_good_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_delivered_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_delivered_agent_desc
			left_icon = scope:qpq_payer
		}
	}
	end_story = yes
}

qpq_pay_on_delivery_effect = {
	scope:qpq_story = {
		# Gold due on delivery: a player payer may still renege
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = var:qpq_gold_due
				var:qpq_gold_due > 0
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_due value = var:qpq_gold_due }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { is_ai = no } }
				scope:qpq_payer = { trigger_event = qpq_pact.20 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { gold >= scope:qpq_due } }
				scope:qpq_payer = {
					pay_short_term_gold = { target = scope:qpq_agent gold = scope:qpq_due }
				}
			}
			else = {
				qpq_payer_reneged_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_offer_titles }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_offer_titles
				limit = { holder ?= scope:qpq_payer }
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:qpq_pay_change }
					clear_saved_scope = qpq_pay_change
				}
				create_title_and_vassal_change = {
					type = granted
					save_scope_as = qpq_pay_change
					add_claim_on_loss = no
				}
				change_title_holder = {
					holder = scope:qpq_agent
					change = scope:qpq_pay_change
				}
				resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_pay_change
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = var:qpq_offer_title
				var:qpq_offer_title.holder ?= scope:qpq_payer
			}
			var:qpq_offer_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_pay_title }
			create_title_and_vassal_change = {
				type = granted
				save_scope_as = qpq_pay_change
				add_claim_on_loss = no
			}
			scope:qpq_pay_title = {
				change_title_holder = {
					holder = scope:qpq_agent
					change = scope:qpq_pay_change
				}
			}
			resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_pay_change
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_offer_artifacts }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_offer_artifacts
				limit = { artifact_owner ?= scope:qpq_payer }
				set_owner = {
					target = scope:qpq_agent
					history = {
						type = given
						actor = scope:qpq_payer
						recipient = scope:qpq_agent
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = var:qpq_offer_artifact
				var:qpq_offer_artifact.artifact_owner ?= scope:qpq_payer
			}
			var:qpq_offer_artifact = {
				set_owner = {
					target = scope:qpq_agent
					history = {
						type = given
						actor = scope:qpq_payer
						recipient = scope:qpq_agent
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_offer_contract }
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_favourable_terms_modifier years = 20 }
			}
			scope:qpq_payer = {
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_conceded_terms_modifier years = 20 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_offer_succession
				scope:qpq_agent = { is_child_of = scope:qpq_payer }
			}
			scope:qpq_payer = { set_designated_heir = scope:qpq_agent }
		}
	}
}

# Payer refused or could not pay on delivery: the agent is the wronged party
qpq_payer_reneged_effect = {
	qpq_mark_wronged_effect = { WRONGED = scope:qpq_agent }
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		add_hook = { type = qpq_broken_pact_hook target = scope:qpq_payer }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_broke_our_pact_opinion }
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_bad_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_reneged_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_reneged_desc
			left_icon = scope:qpq_payer
		}
	}
}

qpq_mark_wronged_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
		scope:qpq_payer_secret = {
			set_variable = { name = qpq_wronged value = $WRONGED$ }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
		scope:qpq_agent_secret = {
			set_variable = { name = qpq_wronged value = $WRONGED$ }
		}
	}
}

qpq_breach_pact_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = qpq_closed value = flag:breached }
	qpq_mark_wronged_effect = { WRONGED = $WRONGED$ }
	$WRONGED$ = {
		add_hook = { type = qpq_broken_pact_hook target = $BREACHER$ }
		add_opinion = { target = $BREACHER$ modifier = qpq_broke_our_pact_opinion }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_charter }
		$BREACHER$ = { add_prestige = medium_prestige_loss }
	}
	$BREACHER$ = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_bad_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_breached_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_breached_breacher_desc
			left_icon = $WRONGED$
		}
	}
	$WRONGED$ = {
		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_generic_bad_text
			title = qpq_msg_pact_breached_title
			desc = qpq_msg_pact_breached_wronged_desc
			left_icon = $BREACHER$
		}
	}
	# The other half of the same deal is released: whoever broke one side cannot hold the other to theirs
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_mate }
		var:qpq_mate = {
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = qpq_released
			}
		}
	}
	end_story = yes
}

qpq_void_pact_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = qpq_closed value = flag:void }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			send_interface_message = {
				type = event_generic_neutral_text
				title = qpq_msg_pact_void_title
				desc = qpq_msg_pact_void_desc
				left_icon = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_agent = {
			send_interface_message = {
				type = event_generic_neutral_text
				title = qpq_msg_pact_void_title
				desc = qpq_msg_pact_void_desc
				left_icon = scope:qpq_payer
			}
		}
	}
	end_story = yes
}

# Story on_end: bookkeeping that must run however the pact closed
qpq_story_cleanup_effect = {
	qpq_load_story_scopes_effect = yes
	qpq_kind_on_end_effect = yes
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story } }
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story } }
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_pacts target = scope:qpq_story }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_protected_by_restraint target = scope:qpq_story } }
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_protected_by_restraint target = scope:qpq_story }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
		scope:qpq_payer_secret = { remove_variable = qpq_story }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
		scope:qpq_agent_secret = { remove_variable = qpq_story }
	}
}

# Story owner (payer) died
qpq_story_owner_died_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes }
		qpq_load_story_scopes_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = qpq_closed value = flag:void }
		end_story = yes
	}
}

# Victors' justice: the winners' half is treated as public, and cheaper to expose
qpq_victors_justice_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
		scope:qpq_agent_secret = { set_variable = qpq_victor }
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain }
}

############################################################
# EXPOSURE
############################################################

# Root: the exposed pact secret. scope:secret_exposer exists.
qpq_on_pact_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_exposure_done } }
		save_scope_as = qpq_exposed_half
		set_variable = qpq_exposure_done
		var:qpq_payer = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
		var:qpq_agent = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_target }
			var:qpq_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_target_title }
			var:qpq_target_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_target_title }
		}
		scope:secret_exposer = { save_scope_as = qpq_exposer }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_kind_is_church_trigger = yes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_simony value = yes }
		}

		# Identify both halves
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_role = flag:payer }
			save_scope_as = qpq_payer_secret
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_twin }
				var:qpq_twin = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent_secret }
			}
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_as = qpq_agent_secret
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_twin }
				var:qpq_twin = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer_secret }
			}
		}

		# A deal made under command: the commander pays for using their authority in the dark
		qpq_command_exposed_effect = yes

		# Price both halves before the twin is consumed
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret }
			scope:qpq_payer_secret = {
				set_variable = qpq_exposure_done
				qpq_price_half_effect = { ROLE = payer }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret }
			scope:qpq_agent_secret = {
				set_variable = qpq_exposure_done
				qpq_price_half_effect = { ROLE = agent }
			}
		}

		# The deal collapses if it was still running
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = var:qpq_story
				var:qpq_story = { qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes }
			}
			var:qpq_story = {
				set_variable = { name = qpq_closed value = flag:exposed }
				save_scope_as = qpq_dead_story
			}
		}

		# Hush Money: exposing a secret you were paid to keep is a breach of that pact
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_hushed_by }
			var:qpq_hushed_by = { save_scope_as = qpq_hush_holder }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:qpq_hush_holder = scope:qpq_exposer
					scope:qpq_hush_holder = { has_variable_list = qpq_pacts }
				}
				scope:qpq_hush_holder = {
					every_in_list = {
						variable = qpq_pacts
						limit = {
							var:qpq_kind = flag:hush_money
							var:qpq_agent ?= scope:qpq_hush_holder
							var:qpq_payer ?= scope:qpq_exposed_half.var:qpq_owner
						}
						set_variable = qpq_agent_exposed_hushed
					}
				}
			}
		}

		# Fallout (computed from the saved prices, before the twin is consumed)
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = 0 }
		qpq_kind_exposed_effect = yes
		qpq_apply_pact_fallout_effect = yes

		# Both halves are linked: exposing one exposes the other
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret
				NOT = { scope:qpq_payer_secret = scope:qpq_exposed_half }
			}
			scope:qpq_payer_secret = { expose_secret = scope:qpq_exposer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret
				NOT = { scope:qpq_agent_secret = scope:qpq_exposed_half }
			}
			scope:qpq_agent_secret = { expose_secret = scope:qpq_exposer }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_dead_story }
			scope:qpq_dead_story = { end_story = yes }
		}

		# The other half of the same deal comes out with this one
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_mate_secret }
			var:qpq_mate_secret = { expose_secret = scope:qpq_exposer }
		}
	}
}

# Root: one half. Saves scope values qpq_<ROLE>_f_tier, qpq_<ROLE>_f_mult, qpq_<ROLE>_f_criminal,
# qpq_<ROLE>_party (current owner), qpq_<ROLE>_victor
qpq_price_half_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_owner }
		var:qpq_owner = { save_scope_as = qpq_$ROLE$_party }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_$ROLE$_f_tier value = qpq_effective_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_$ROLE$_f_mult value = qpq_$ROLE$_share_value }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_victor }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_$ROLE$_victor value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_$ROLE$_is_criminal_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_$ROLE$_f_criminal value = yes }
	}
}






# Applies the fallout menu to both halves, then the pact-level consequences
qpq_apply_pact_fallout_effect = {
	# Who exposed less of their own guilt (gets hooked by the victim)
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_exposer = scope:qpq_payer }
		scope:qpq_agent = { save_scope_as = qpq_less_guilty }
	}
	else = {
		scope:qpq_payer = { save_scope_as = qpq_less_guilty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_title.holder }
		scope:qpq_target_title.holder = { save_scope_as = qpq_victim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		scope:qpq_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_victim }
	}

	# Payer half
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_party
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_f_tier
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = scope:qpq_payer_f_tier }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_mult value = scope:qpq_payer_f_mult }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_f_criminal }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = yes }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = no }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer_party = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_victor }
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
			}
			else = {
				qpq_apply_half_fallout_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# Agent half
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_agent_party
			exists = scope:qpq_agent_f_tier
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = scope:qpq_agent_f_tier }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_mult value = scope:qpq_agent_f_mult }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_f_criminal }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = yes }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_criminal value = no }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent_party = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent_victor }
				# A rebel who won on foreign gold gains prestige when it comes out
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			}
			else = {
				qpq_apply_half_fallout_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Pact-level consequences, keyed on the worse of the two halves
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = qpq_f_tier
		value = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_f_tier }
				value = scope:qpq_payer_f_tier
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:qpq_agent_f_tier
					scope:qpq_agent_f_tier > scope:qpq_payer_f_tier
				}
				value = scope:qpq_agent_f_tier
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_victim
			scope:qpq_victim = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_f_tier >= 3
			NOT = { scope:qpq_victim = scope:qpq_less_guilty }
		}
		scope:qpq_victim = {
			add_hook = { type = qpq_leverage_hook target = scope:qpq_less_guilty }
		}
	}
	# "Avenge Perfidy": the victim gains a casus belli against the payer
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_victim
			scope:qpq_victim = { is_alive = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_f_tier
			scope:qpq_payer_f_tier >= 4
			NOT = { scope:qpq_victim = scope:qpq_payer }
		}
		scope:qpq_victim = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:qpq_payer
				modifier = qpq_avenge_perfidy_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	# Buying holiness weakens the whole faith: exposure of a head-of-faith pact costs Fervor
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_f_simony
			scope:qpq_f_tier >= 1
		}
		scope:qpq_agent.faith = {
			change_fervor = {
				value = qpq_f_fervor_loss_value
				desc = qpq_fervor_pact_exposed
			}
		}
	}

	# Notifications
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes }
			trigger_event = qpq_expose.1
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes }
			trigger_event = qpq_expose.1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = {
				scope:qpq_exposer = scope:qpq_payer
				scope:qpq_exposer = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
		scope:qpq_exposer = { trigger_event = qpq_expose.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_victim
			scope:qpq_victim = { is_alive = yes }
			NOR = {
				scope:qpq_victim = scope:qpq_payer
				scope:qpq_victim = scope:qpq_agent
				scope:qpq_victim = scope:qpq_exposer
			}
		}
		scope:qpq_victim = { trigger_event = qpq_expose.3 }
	}
}

# Root: the party paying for one half. Scope values qpq_f_tier, qpq_f_mult, qpq_f_criminal.
qpq_apply_half_fallout_effect = {
	save_scope_as = qpq_f_party
	# Trust: whoever deals in the dark is known for it. Everyone who serves or rules beside them hears.
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 1 }
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = qpq_distrusted_modifier
			years = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = honest
					has_trait = just
					has_trait = zealous
				}
			}
			add_stress = medium_stress_gain
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = liege }
			liege = {
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:qpq_f_party
					modifier = qpq_distrust_opinion
					opinion = qpq_f_distrust_opinion_value
				}
			}
		}
		every_vassal = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:qpq_f_party
				modifier = qpq_distrust_opinion
				opinion = qpq_f_distrust_opinion_value
			}
		}
		every_courtier = {
			limit = { is_adult = yes }
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:qpq_f_party
				modifier = qpq_distrust_opinion
				opinion = qpq_f_distrust_opinion_value
			}
		}
	}
	# A deal broken on top of it: the wronged party's version of events spreads
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_exposed_half
			scope:qpq_exposed_half = { exists = var:qpq_wronged }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_exposed_half.var:qpq_wronged ?= scope:qpq_f_party }
			scope:qpq_f_tier >= 1
		}
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = qpq_oathbreaker_modifier
			years = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = liege }
			liege = {
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:qpq_f_party
					modifier = qpq_oathbreaker_opinion
				}
			}
		}
		every_vassal = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:qpq_f_party
				modifier = qpq_oathbreaker_opinion
			}
		}
		every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:qpq_f_party
				modifier = qpq_oathbreaker_opinion
			}
		}
		add_piety = qpq_f_oathbreaker_piety_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 1 }
		# Prestige loss, or Dread for rulers who already lean on it
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_f_tier >= 4
				qpq_leans_on_dread_trigger = yes
			}
			add_dread = qpq_f_dread_gain_value
		}
		else = {
			add_prestige = qpq_f_prestige_loss_value
		}
		# Rivals who were not offered the same
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_f_tier = 1
				exists = scope:qpq_payer_party
				this = scope:qpq_payer_party
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent } }
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:qpq_f_party
					modifier = qpq_played_favourites_opinion
					opinion = qpq_f_favourites_opinion_value
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_f_mult >= 50 }
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = qpq_known_schemer_modifier
				years = 8
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = qpq_rumoured_schemer_modifier
				years = 5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_uses_legitimacy_trigger = yes }
			add_legitimacy = qpq_f_legitimacy_loss_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_uses_influence_trigger = yes }
			change_influence = qpq_f_influence_loss_value
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 3 }
		# The victim, their house and their allies
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:qpq_victim
				scope:qpq_victim = {
					is_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_f_party }
				}
			}
			scope:qpq_victim = {
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:qpq_f_party
					modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion
					opinion = qpq_f_betrayed_opinion_value
				}
				every_ally = {
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_f_party } }
					add_opinion = {
						target = scope:qpq_f_party
						modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_ally_opinion
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = house.house_head
						NOT = { house.house_head = this }
						NOT = { house.house_head = scope:qpq_f_party }
					}
					house.house_head = {
						add_opinion = {
							target = scope:qpq_f_party
							modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# Small, capped bump to faction discontent: no pact pushes a vassal into a faction on its own
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_targeting_faction = yes
				NOT = {
					any_targeting_faction = { faction_discontent >= 50 }
				}
			}
			add_targeting_factions_discontent = qpq_f_discontent_value
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 4 }
		# Criminal: grounds to imprison or revoke
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_f_criminal = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = liege }
				liege = {
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 5 }
						add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_f_party modifier = qpq_damnable_pact_opinion }
					}
					else = {
						add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_f_party modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:qpq_victim
					scope:qpq_victim = {
						is_alive = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:qpq_f_party }
					}
				}
				scope:qpq_victim = {
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 5 }
						add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_f_party modifier = qpq_damnable_pact_opinion }
					}
					else = {
						add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_f_party modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_piety = qpq_f_piety_loss_value
		# Excommunication risk
		if = {
			limit = {
				qpq_faith_has_hof_trigger = yes
				faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_trait = excommunicated }
			}
			random = {
				chance = qpq_f_excommunication_chance_value
				faith.religious_head = { save_scope_as = qpq_f_hof }
				excommunicate_character = {
					REQUESTING_CHARACTER = scope:qpq_f_hof
					EXCOMMUNICATOR = scope:qpq_f_hof
					TARGET_CHARACTER = scope:qpq_f_party
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_f_tier >= 5 }
		# The whole house shares the shame
		if = {
			limit = { exists = dynasty }
			dynasty = { add_dynasty_prestige = qpq_f_renown_loss_value }
		}
		# Kinslayer if it applies
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:qpq_victim
				scope:qpq_victim = { is_alive = no }
				is_close_or_extended_family_of = scope:qpq_victim
			}
			add_kinslayer_trait_or_nothing_effect = { VICTIM = scope:qpq_victim }
		}
	}
}

############################################################
# INHERITANCE AND STALENESS
############################################################

# Secret on_owner_death. Tier I-III die with their members; Tier IV-V pass to heirs at one tier lower.
qpq_pact_secret_owner_death_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_tier >= 4
			OR = {
				var:qpq_heir ?= { is_alive = yes }
				var:qpq_owner.house.house_head ?= { is_alive = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_heir ?= { is_alive = yes } }
			var:qpq_heir = { save_scope_as = qpq_new_owner }
		}
		else = {
			var:qpq_owner.house.house_head = { save_scope_as = qpq_new_owner }
		}
		set_secret_owner = scope:qpq_new_owner
		set_variable = { name = qpq_owner value = scope:qpq_new_owner }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_tier add = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_new_owner.primary_heir }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_heir value = scope:qpq_new_owner.primary_heir }
		}
		scope:qpq_new_owner = {
			send_interface_message = {
				type = event_generic_bad_text
				title = qpq_msg_inherited_stain_title
				desc = qpq_msg_inherited_stain_desc
			}
		}
	}
}

# Yearly upkeep on a character's own pact halves (keeps the heir pointer current)
qpq_yearly_secret_upkeep_effect = {
	every_secret = {
		limit = { qpq_is_pact_secret_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = prev.primary_heir }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_heir value = prev.primary_heir }
		}
	}
}

############################################################
# CONFESSION
############################################################

# Root: the confessor. scope:qpq_confess_half = their own half. PENANCE = gold/piety/pilgrimage
qpq_confess_pact_effect = {
	save_scope_as = qpq_confessor
	scope:qpq_confess_half = {
		set_variable = { name = qpq_confessed_by value = scope:qpq_confessor }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_confessor = {
					OR = {
						health <= 1
						has_trait = incapable
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = qpq_deathbed
			# Tier IV-V fallout passes to the heir
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:qpq_tier >= 4
					exists = scope:qpq_confessor.primary_heir
				}
				scope:qpq_confessor.primary_heir = {
					add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_heir_of_a_confession_modifier years = 10 }
					add_prestige = medium_prestige_loss
				}
			}
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_f_tier value = var:qpq_tier }
		# Forfeit payment: an agent hands back what they were paid up front
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:qpq_role = flag:agent
				exists = var:qpq_story
				exists = var:qpq_story.var:qpq_gold_total
			}
			scope:qpq_confessor = {
				pay_short_term_gold = {
					target = scope:qpq_confess_half.var:qpq_payer
					gold = {
						value = scope:qpq_confess_half.var:qpq_story.var:qpq_gold_total
						max = scope:qpq_confessor.gold
						min = 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_penance = flag:gold }
		# A church takes penance; every other faith expects alms given to the poor
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_pays_penance_to_church_trigger = yes }
			pay_short_term_gold = { target = faith.religious_head gold = qpq_confession_penance_gold_value }
		}
		else = {
			remove_short_term_gold = qpq_confession_penance_gold_value
			add_piety = minor_piety_gain
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_penance = flag:piety }
		add_piety = qpq_confession_penance_piety_value
	}
	else = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_owes_pilgrimage_modifier years = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_owes_pilgrimage value = scope:qpq_f_tier years = 5 }
	}
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_penitent_modifier years = 5 }
	stress_impact = {
		honest = major_stress_impact_loss
		zealous = medium_stress_impact_loss
		base = minor_stress_impact_loss
	}
	scope:qpq_confess_half = { expose_secret = scope:qpq_confessor }
}

############################################################
# RENEGOTIATION (blackmail before exposure)
############################################################

# The cover-up is worse: paying hush money is its own Tier II pact about the original secret
# Root: none. scope:qpq_hush_payer pays scope:qpq_hush_agent to keep scope:qpq_hush_secret quiet.
qpq_seal_hush_money_effect = {
	scope:qpq_hush_payer = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:qpq_hush_agent = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = 2 }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = 2 }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_charter value = no }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold value = no }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold_lavish value = no }
	scope:qpq_hush_payer = {
		pay_short_term_gold = {
			target = scope:qpq_hush_agent
			gold = scope:qpq_hush_price
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_hush_secret = { qpq_is_pact_secret_trigger = yes } }
		scope:qpq_hush_secret = { set_variable = qpq_cover_up }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_hush_secret = { exists = var:qpq_twin } }
			scope:qpq_hush_secret.var:qpq_twin = { set_variable = qpq_cover_up }
		}
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = hush_money SECRET = bribery TERM = 120 }
}

############################################################
# AI SECRET HANDLING (exposure and renegotiation by AI holders)
############################################################

# Root: an AI character. Considers burning or milking one pact secret they know about.
qpq_ai_secret_pulse_effect = {
	save_scope_as = qpq_ai_blackmailer
	random_known_secret = {
		limit = {
			qpq_is_pact_secret_trigger = yes
			NOT = { secret_owner = root }
			secret_owner = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_secret
		secret_owner = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_secret_owner }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_ai_secret }
		# Wronged parties burn cheaply; third parties burn for free; partners mostly keep quiet
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:qpq_ai_secret.var:qpq_wronged ?= root
					AND = {
						NOT = { scope:qpq_ai_secret.var:qpq_payer = root }
						NOT = { scope:qpq_ai_secret.var:qpq_agent = root }
					}
				}
				opinion = { target = scope:qpq_ai_secret_owner value <= -20 }
			}
			random_list = {
				40 = {
					# Blackmail before exposure: most of the drama should live here
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_ai_secret_owner = { is_ai = no } }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_reneg_tier value = scope:qpq_ai_secret.var:qpq_tier }
						scope:qpq_ai_secret_owner = { save_scope_as = recipient }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_hush_price value = qpq_renegotiate_demand_value }
						clear_saved_scope = recipient
						scope:qpq_ai_secret_owner = { trigger_event = qpq_expose.20 }
					}
				}
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						add = 30
						has_relation_rival = scope:qpq_ai_secret_owner
					}
					scope:qpq_ai_secret = { expose_secret = root }
				}
				40 = {
					# keep the dirt for later
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Root: a pact story. Copies what the agent's Situations entry shows onto their mirror story.
qpq_sync_mirror_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_mirror }
		var:qpq_mirror = {
			set_variable = { name = qpq_months_left value = prev.var:qpq_months_left }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_term value = prev.var:qpq_term }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = prev.var:qpq_payer_tier }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = prev.var:qpq_agent_tier }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gold_due }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_stipend }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_paid_now }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_title }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_artifact }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_target_artifact }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_contract }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_succession }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_office }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_restraint }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_claim }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_hook_release }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_my_word }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_secret }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_clemency }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_arms }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_gave_church }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_used_hook }
			qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_charter }
		}
	}
}

# Root: the mirror story; prev: the main story
qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = prev.var:$VAR$ }
		set_variable = { name = $VAR$ value = prev.var:$VAR$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = var:$VAR$ }
		remove_variable = $VAR$
	}
}
